scope: All Git-listed first-party nonignored Markdown/text, including both KGR catalogs. Historical audit Markdown is read as evidence, not indexed as new product obligations. Current generated outputs are excluded from their own read receipts.

status_policy.Done: Full acceptance verified by fresh source-bound automated/manual evidence and review.
status_policy.Partial: Implementation/test discovery leads exist; acceptance has not been established.
status_policy.Missing: Evidence mapping missing; implementation absence is not yet established.

limitations: This is a complete mechanical content scan, not a complete line-by-line semantic audit.
Explicit IDs can denote references, tasks or examples; unnumbered candidates are not yet atomic requirements.
Range/wildcard shorthand requires semantic expansion; counts are not a complete requirement total.
No product requirement is promoted to Done by this tool; historical reports and CI are not fresh verification.
Uncommitted user-owned API/readiness changes are visible leads but excluded from the phase commit.

runtime_progress.scope: Recorded local JUnit outcomes and canonical seed inventory, not live graph totals.
limitations: JUnit alone does not record the process exit code or certify remote CI.
Absent receipts are UNVERIFIED; no running test is treated as passing.
Seed inventory is not a product-requirement completion percentage.
